text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Sunday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria to set up on Sunday a national commission to prepare for referendum to amend constitution promised this year.
- President Zeroual reasserts policy to rally broad support for reforms aimed at building real democracy and efficient economic development.
- Zeroual, who announced he has invited opposition parties to join in government, showed in news conference that he was sure of himself, his programme and approach to ending crisis.
- Zeroual hints that state of emergency imposed since 1992 might be lifted but does not say when.
